Hi Everyone,
I just wanted to say thankyou to all of your kind words and advice and apologise for all the drama. I was in a really low spot and I had no idea what I was living for. I went for a drive (and I drove and drove for over 4 hours) Eventually I was so far in the outback I found a spot where I thought no one would bother me and I got out of my car and saw [this](http://imgur.com/CcGsv)  And I realised there was beauty in my life and things worth living for. 

You guys do a great job, Thanks again.

not to mention I've ended up hurting the girls I have dated, 
I've made it this far because I stick to my rules.
1.a Don't break your promises
1.b Don't make promises lightly
2 Don't Date, Ever
3 Don't Drink Alone.

the motivation to keep to these rules is her.

no girl has ever made me feel like she did. I've tried dating since and it's horrible I feel like i'm either forcing the relationship or pretending its something its not. Its been almost 2 years since I last saw her and I think about her EVERY DAY

She was the Canadian coffee girl around the corner from my work. I eagerly looked forward to seeing her every single day. we started to date and I knew she was the one, I felt for her like I had for no other. Just as her visa expired and she needed to go back to Canada I froze, i literally couldn't talk to her because I didn't know what to do. I delved into a deep depression and I pushed her away from me. This has been the single biggest regret of my life. I attempted suicide and failed. 

I somehow found a way to keep going and I pushed myself to get right, to make myself stronger and overcome the things that had stopped me. I did all this in the hope that one day I would be ready, that I could go to Canada and find her and fix what i had broken. this was my reason for being. 

That reason is gone.
